title: The Ferryman
text: A black river, slow and wide, and a ferryman leaning on his pole with his hand out. His face is hidden under a hood. He takes coin, he says, or a memory, whichever is dearer. He does not take no.

options.label: Pay the ferryman in coin, everyone.

outcomes.text: It is a great deal of coin, and he counts it with long grey fingers.
Everyone forgets something. Nobody can say what. Everyone keeps looking for it.

options.label: The hardiest swims a rope across his river.

outcomes.text: They make it across, half drowned, and drag a rope for the rest.
The river is not water, and it does not want to give them back.
